items.stem: A rectangle has a length of 8 centimeters and a width of 5 centimeters. What is the area of the rectangle, in square centimeters?
items.explanation: Площадь = длина · ширина = 40 см² (C). 26 — периметр; 13 — половина периметра; 80 — удвоили.

items.stem: A triangle has a base of 10 inches and a height of 6 inches. What is the area of the triangle, in square inches?
items.explanation: Площадь треугольника = основание · высота / 2 = 60/2 = 30. Без деления на 2 получится площадь прямоугольника.

items.stem: A cube has edges of length 3 meters. What is the volume of the cube, in cubic meters?
items.explanation: Объём куба = a³ = 27 м³ (C). 9 — площадь грани; 54 — площадь поверхности; 18 — 2 · 9.

items.stem: A circle has a radius of 4. What is the area of the circle?
items.explanation: S = πr² = 16π (C). 8π — длина окружности; 4π — забыли квадрат; 64π — возвели в квадрат диаметр.

items.stem: A rectangular prism has dimensions 4 feet, 5 feet, and 6 feet. What is the volume of the prism, in cubic feet?
items.explanation: Объём = длина · ширина · высота = 4 · 5 · 6 = 120 кубических футов.

items.stem: A square has an area of 49 square units. What is the length of one side of the square?
items.explanation: Сторона = √49 = 7 (A). 12.25 — 49/4, путают с периметром; 24.5 — 49/2; 49 — сама площадь.

items.stem: A cylinder has a radius of 2 and a height of 5. What is the volume of the cylinder?
items.explanation: V = πr²h = π · 4 · 5 = 20π (B). 10π — забыли квадрат радиуса; 40π — взяли 2r; 100π — возвели 10 в квадрат.

items.stem: A rectangle has an area of 54 square meters and a width of 6 meters. What is the length of the rectangle, in meters?
items.explanation: Длина = площадь / ширина = 54/6 = 9 м.

items.stem: A parallelogram has a base of 12 centimeters and a height of 7 centimeters. What is its area, in square centimeters?
items.explanation: Площадь параллелограмма = основание · высота = 84 (D). 42 — разделили на 2, как у треугольника; 38 и 19 — сложили.

items.stem: A storage box is 2 meters long, 3 meters wide, and 1.5 meters tall. What is its volume, in cubic meters?
items.explanation: 2 · 3 · 1.5 = 9 м³ (B). 6.5 — сумма измерений; 18 — забыли, что высота 1.5, а не 3; 13 — ошибка.

items.stem: A trapezoid has parallel sides of lengths 6 and 10 and a height of 4. What is the area of the trapezoid?
The volume of a sphere with radius r is V = (4/3)πr³. What is the volume of a sphere with radius 3?
items.explanation: (4/3) · π · 27 = 36π (C). 27π — забыли 4/3; 108π — умножили на 4 без деления на 3; 12π — r² вместо r³.

items.stem: A rectangular garden is 15 meters long and 8 meters wide. How many meters of fencing are needed to go around the garden once?
items.explanation: Периметр = 2(15 + 8) = 46 м (B). 120 — площадь; 23 — половина периметра; 60 — ошибка.

items.stem: A cube has a volume of 64 cubic inches. What is the length of one edge of the cube, in inches?
items.explanation: Ребро = ∛64 = 4, потому что 4 · 4 · 4 = 64.

items.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 9 and 12. What is the area of the triangle?
items.explanation: Катеты — основание и высота: 9 · 12 / 2 = 54 (C). 108 — без деления на 2; 15 — гипотенуза; 21 — сумма катетов.

items.stem: The length of a rectangle is doubled and its width is tripled. By what factor is the area of the rectangle multiplied?
items.explanation: Новая площадь (2l)(3w) = 6lw (B). 5 — сложили множители; 9 и 36 — возвели в квадрат.

items.stem: A cylinder has a volume of 72π cubic centimeters and a radius of 3 centimeters. What is the height of the cylinder, in centimeters?
A right circular cone has a radius of 3 and a height of 8. The volume of a cone is V = (1/3)πr²h. What is the volume of this cone?
items.explanation: (1/3) · π · 9 · 8 = 24π (B). 72π — объём цилиндра с теми же размерами; 8π — r вместо r²; 96π — ошибка в множителях.

items.stem: A square has a perimeter of 36 inches. What is the area of the square, in square inches?
items.explanation: Сторона 36/4 = 9, площадь 81 (B). 36 — путают периметр и площадь; 144 — сторона 12; 324 — 36 · 9.

items.stem: A rectangular tank measures 50 centimeters by 40 centimeters by 30 centimeters. How many liters of water does the tank hold when it is full? (1 liter = 1,000 cubic centimeters)
items.explanation: Объём 50 · 40 · 30 = 60 000 см³ = 60 литров.

items.stem: A circle has a circumference of 10π. What is the area of the circle?
items.explanation: 2πr = 10π, r = 5, площадь 25π (C). 100π — взяли r = 10; 5π и 10π — путают радиус и площадь.

items.stem: A room is 12 feet wide and 15 feet long. Carpet costs $3.50 per square foot. What is the cost of carpeting the entire floor?
A cube has a total surface area of 150 square centimeters. What is the volume of the cube, in cubic centimeters?
items.explanation: 6 граней: каждая 150/6 = 25 см², ребро 5 см, объём 5³ = 125 см³.

items.stem: A triangle has an area of 36 square meters and a base of 9 meters. What is the height of the triangle, in meters?
items.explanation: 36 = 9h/2, h = 72/9 = 8 (B). 4 — забыли множитель 2; 27 и 18 — ошибки.

items.stem: Two rectangles are similar, and the sides of the larger rectangle are 3 times as long as the corresponding sides of the smaller rectangle. The area of the smaller rectangle is 10 square units. What is the area of the larger rectangle?
items.explanation: Площади подобных фигур относятся как квадрат коэффициента: 10 · 9 = 90 (C). 30 — умножили на 3; 270 — на 27 (как объём).

items.stem: A rectangular prism has a volume of 360 cubic units, a length of 10 units, and a width of 6 units. What is the height of the prism, in units?
What is the area of a semicircle with a diameter of 12?
items.explanation: r = 6, площадь круга 36π, полукруга 18π (B). 36π — забыли половину; 72π — взяли диаметр; 6π — r вместо r².

items.stem: A swimming pool is 25 meters long, 10 meters wide, and 2 meters deep everywhere. How many cubic meters of water does it hold when full?
items.explanation: 25 · 10 · 2 = 500 м³ (C). 250 — площадь дна; 37 — сумма измерений; 5000 — лишний ноль.

items.stem: The area of a circle is 49π square inches. What is the diameter of the circle, in inches?
items.explanation: r² = 49, r = 7, диаметр 14.

items.stem: A square and a rectangle have the same area. The rectangle is 4 units by 16 units. What is the side length of the square?
items.explanation: Площадь 64, сторона квадрата √64 = 8 (B). 10 — средняя сторона (4 + 16)/2 даёт тот же периметр, а не площадь; 64 — сама площадь.

items.stem: The radius of a cylinder is doubled and its height is cut in half. By what factor does the volume of the cylinder change?
items.explanation: V = πr²h: радиус в квадрате даёт ×4, высота — ×1/2, итого ×2 (C). 1 — решили, что изменения компенсируются; 4 — забыли про высоту.

items.stem: A sphere has a volume of 288π cubic units. What is the radius of the sphere? (The volume of a sphere is V = (4/3)πr³.)
A rectangular box has a square base with side length s and a height of 2s. The volume of the box is 128 cubic units. What is the value of s?
items.explanation: V = s · s · 2s = 2s³ = 128, s³ = 64, s = 4 (B). 8 — высота 2s; 16 — площадь основания; 2 — ошибка в степени.

items.stem: A frame of uniform width 2 centimeters surrounds a rectangular photo that is 10 centimeters by 15 centimeters. What is the area of the frame alone, in square centimeters?
items.explanation: Внешний прямоугольник (10 + 4) × (15 + 4) = 266, минус фото 150 — рамка 116 (C). 266 — вся площадь; 100 — добавили 2 см только с одной стороны; 50 — периметр · 1.

items.stem: A right circular cone and a right circular cylinder have the same radius and the same height. The volume of the cylinder is 54 cubic inches. What is the volume of the cone, in cubic inches?
items.explanation: Объём конуса — треть объёма цилиндра с тем же основанием и высотой: 54/3 = 18.

items.stem: A circle is inscribed in a square with side length 10, so the circle touches all four sides of the square. What is the area of the region inside the square but outside the circle?
items.explanation: Радиус вписанного круга 5, его площадь 25π; квадрат 100. Разность 100 − 25π (A). B — радиус 10 (тогда результат отрицательный); C — вычли длину окружности; D — площадь самого круга.

items.stem: A rectangular prism has a volume of 240 cubic units. Each of its three dimensions is multiplied by 1.5. What is the volume of the new prism?
items.explanation: Объём растёт в 1.5³ = 3.375 раза: 240 · 3.375 = 810 (C). 360 — умножили на 1.5; 540 — на 2.25 (как площадь); 1215 — лишний множитель.

items.stem: A hollow cylindrical pipe is 10 meters long. Its outer radius is 0.5 meter and its inner radius is 0.4 meter. What is the volume of the material that makes up the pipe, in cubic meters, rounded to the nearest hundredth?
items.explanation: Объём материала = π · 10 · (0.5² − 0.4²) = π · 10 · 0.09 = 0.9π ≈ 2.83 м³. Нельзя брать (0.5 − 0.4)²: вычитаются площади кругов.

items.stem: The diagonal of a square has a length of 8√2 centimeters. What is the area of the square, in square centimeters?
items.explanation: Диагональ квадрата = сторона · √2, значит сторона 8 и площадь 64 (B). 128 — (8√2)²; 32 — половина; 64√2 — лишний корень.

items.stem: A rectangular field has a perimeter of 140 meters, and its length is 30 meters more than its width. What is the area of the field, in square meters?
items.explanation: l + w = 70 и l − w = 30: w = 20, l = 50, площадь 1000 (B). 4900 — квадрат полупериметра; 1200 и 900 — неверные стороны.

items.stem: A cylindrical can has a height of 12 centimeters and a volume of 300π cubic centimeters. What is the diameter of the can, in centimeters?
items.explanation: r² · 12 = 300, r² = 25, r = 5, диаметр 10.

items.stem: The legs of a right triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4, and the area of the triangle is 54 square units. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
items.explanation: Катеты 3k и 4k, площадь 6k² = 54, k = 3: катеты 9 и 12, гипотенуза 15 (B). 12 — больший катет; 18 и 21 — ошибки в k.

items.stem: A water tank in the shape of a cube with edges of 2 meters is half full. Water is pumped into the tank at a rate of 0.5 cubic meter per minute. How many minutes will it take to fill the tank completely?
items.explanation: Объём 8 м³, не хватает 4 м³; 4/0.5 = 8 минут (B). 16 — время для пустого бака; 4 — недостающий объём.

items.stem: The ratio of the surface areas of two cubes is 4 : 9. What is the ratio of the volume of the smaller cube to the volume of the larger cube, written as a fraction?
items.explanation: Отношение площадей — квадрат отношения рёбер: рёбра 2 : 3. Объёмы — куб: 8 : 27.

items.stem: A right circular cone has a volume of 100π cubic centimeters and a height of 12 centimeters. What is the radius of the base of the cone, in centimeters? (V = (1/3)πr²h)
items.explanation: (1/3) · r² · 12 = 100, 4r² = 100, r = 5 (A). 25 — это r²; 5√3 — получится, если разделить 300 на 4 вместо 12 (r² = 75); 10 — диаметр.
